## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behavior
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] Uncertain results are reported as `inferred`/`unresolved`, never as confirmed
- [ ] No AI, network access, or unauthorized command execution added
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
